payments.intro: How clients pay deposits, and the business details shown on your booking page.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.blurb: Deposits are paid through Stripe on your own account — Booklo never holds the money and takes no fee.
stripe.notConfigured: Payments aren't set up on this server.
stripe.notConnected: Connect Stripe to collect deposits online. Bookings that need a deposit are held until it's paid.
stripe.onboarding: Stripe still needs some details before you can take payments.
stripe.active: Active — clients can pay deposits online.
stripe.restricted: Stripe has paused payments on this account and needs more information.

notice.returnIncomplete: Stripe still needs a few details — continue setup when you're ready.
notice.error: Couldn't reach Stripe. Try again in a moment.

hold.title: Payment window
hold.blurb: How long a booking is held for its deposit. Unpaid bookings are released automatically.
hold.label: Hold for

legal.title: Business details
legal.blurb: Shown in the footer of your booking page. Przelewy24 requires them for online payments.

status.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.

push.testFailed: Nothing went out. Enable a device first.

reminders.blurb: An email to each client before their booking.

alwaysSent.title: Always sent to clients

google.title: Google Calendar
google.blurb: Bookings appear in your calendar; Busy time in it blocks your booking page.
google.notConfigured: Google Calendar is not set up on this server yet.
google.proOnly: Google Calendar sync is a premium feature.
google.paused: Sync is paused: Google Calendar sync is a premium feature. Your connection is kept.
google.anotherHint: One account per person, or one shared calendar for the whole business.
google.needsReconnect: Google no longer accepts this connection. Reconnect to resume.
google.belongsToPersonHint: Their bookings go here; Busy time here blocks only their slots.
google.belongsToSharedHint: Busy time here blocks every person and every space; bookings without a person go here.
google.blockFromHint: Anything marked Busy in a ticked calendar can't be booked. Events marked Free are ignored.
google.disconnectNote: Events already added to Google stay there.

notice.connected: Google Calendar connected. Upcoming bookings are on their way.

error.plan: Google Calendar sync is a premium feature.
error.state: That link has expired. Try connecting again.
error.google: Google didn't complete the connection. Try again.
error.no_calendars: That Google account has no calendars.

google.inviteClients: Invite clients to the Google event
google.inviteClientsHint: They get a Google Calendar invitation from your account, on top of Booklo's confirmation email.
google.cancelOnDelete: When I delete or decline the event in Google, cancel the booking
google.rescheduleOnMove: When I move the event in Google, reschedule the booking
google.inboundHint: Booklo emails the client either way. A move that isn't possible is put back and you're told why.
google.watching: Google tells Booklo about changes as they happen.
google.polling: Booklo checks Google for changes every 15 minutes.

how.title: How it works
how.push: Every confirmed booking becomes an event in the calendar you choose. Cancellations, reschedules and accepted requests keep it in step.
how.busy: Anything marked Busy in the calendars you tick can't be booked — on your booking page and in reschedule pickers.
how.record: Change a booking in Booklo, or — with the switches on — delete or move the event in Google and Booklo follows, emailing the client.
